description.zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The key of tag N. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

description.zh:

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of tag N. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` and `acs:`.
